scenarios.name: analytics_service_unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Dashboard and direct analytics calls should fail fast while ingestion and processing continue.

scenarios.name: redis_unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Analytics cache hit rate drops and APIs should fall back to PostgreSQL in a production-hardened implementation.

scenarios.name: kafka_unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Ingestion publish failures increase, no event loss is accepted without client retry or producer retry success.

scenarios.name: postgres_unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Processing and analytics fail health checks; ingestion can validate but cannot complete end-to-end flow.
